programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.sub-title: Omar Sy, Florence Foresti et Stromaé
programme.desc: Les parcours de Florence Foresti, Omar Sy et Stromae, de leurs débuts au sommet de leur carrière.

programme.title: Stars Connexions
programme.desc: Les destins de Squeezie, Angèle et Kendji Girac, révélés par le web, la musique et le talent.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Une grande fresque épique et spectaculaire au cœur des aventures d'Ulysse ?

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Walt Disney, le rêveur éveillé
programme.desc: Mêlant archives et interviews, ce documentaire dévoile qui était l'homme derrière le légendaire Walt Disney.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Let's Dance: Davai, tantsyui!
programme.desc: Nikita, jeune danseur talentueux, s'inscrit au concours « Let's Dance » dans l'espoir de gagner le grand prix et ainsi pouvoir payer l'opération dont son petit frère a besoin.

programme.title: Allumeuses!
programme.desc: Trois amies croquent la vie à pleines dents et n'ont pas besoin d'hommes pour être heureuses. Jusqu'au jour où l'une d'entre elles tombe amoureuse... Christina s'est toujours efforcée de respecter une règle d'or en matière de mecs: "Eviter toute relation sérieuse avec le sexe opposé".

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: C'est un peu l'impasse dans la vie des amies de toujours Kate (Mamrie Hart), Evie (Grace Helbig) et Charlie (Hannah Hart). A la veille de son trentième anniversaire, Kate accepte de laisser Evie et Charlie lui organiser une fête.

programme.title: Very Good Girls
programme.desc: Lors de leur premier été après la fin du lycée, deux adolescentes new-yorkaises se promettent de perdre leur virginité. Lorsqu'elles tombent toutes les deux amoureuses du même artiste de street art, l'amitié des deux jeunes filles est mise à rude épreuve pour la première fois.

programme.title: Blue State
programme.desc: Dans cette charmante comédie romantique, un fervent libéral (Breckin Meyer), après la défaite de son candidat aux élection, tient sa promesse de partir au Canada et rencontre en chemin une jeune femme aussi sexy que mystérieuse (Anna Paquin).

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: I Love My Mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s'installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d'envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d'en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: The Happiness Playbook
programme.desc: Des étincelles jaillissent lorsqu'une journaliste infiltrée commence à tomber amoureuse du sujet de son reportage.

programme.title: Yes, God, Yes
programme.desc: Au début des années 2000, une adolescente catholique et bien rangée découvre la tentation sur un chat aol.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Les bas-fonds de Melbourne, dans un futur proche. Macbeth est le bras droit de Duncan, le parrain local.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome de Gilles de la Tourette, rencontre Marie et Alex dans une clinique.

programme.title: The Ten
programme.desc: Une parodie en dix histoires courtes inspirées des dix commandements.

programme.title: Cuisiner n'est pas Jouer
programme.desc: Lilah, cheffe passionnée, voit son restaurant racheté par Charlie, un entrepreneur technologique décidé à le moderniser. Mais en découvrant leur quartier et ses traditions, Charlie pourrait revoir toutes ses priorités.

programme.title: Marcher vers l'amour
programme.desc: Pour sauver son musée en difficulté, une conservatrice traditionnelle collabore avec un artiste d'avant-garde. Ensemble, ils créent une exposition originale qui pourrait transformer leur vie… et leurs sentiments.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Une critique gastronomique renommée croise la route d'un chef refusant les critiques culinaires lors du mariage de sa sœur. Entre tensions et attirance, ils devront apprendre à se comprendre avant le grand jour.

programme.title: Un amour d'animateur
programme.desc: Savannah, mère célibataire et graphiste ambitieuse, est engagée pour moderniser une célèbre émission radio new-yorkaise. En travaillant avec son animateur charmeur, elle découvre que l'amour pourrait bouleverser ses plans.

programme.title: Un amour inattendu
programme.desc: Piper, célèbre commentatrice sportive et mère célibataire, doit collaborer avec Erik, un père aussi têtu qu'elle, pour monter la pièce Roméo et Juliette après une affaire de harcèlement scolaire impliquant leurs enfants.

programme.title: JOE LA CRASSE
programme.desc: Joe Dirt est portier. Il rêve de retrouver ses parents qu'il a perdu au Grand Canyon quand il avait huit ans. Sa quête va le conduire à vivre de folles aventures.

programme.title: L'an 1 : Des Debuts Difficiles
programme.desc: Deux "chasseurs-cueilleurs" feignants sont bannis de leur village natal. Ils se lancent alors dans une odyssée à travers un monde primitif.

programme.title: Paul Blart : Super Vigile
programme.desc: Doux et réfléchi, un agent de sécurité passe à l'action lorsque le supermarché dans lequel il travaille est la proie d'une bande de cambrioleurs très bien organisée. Il sera accompagné d'une vendeuse d'extensions de cheveux

programme.title: Amour & Amnésie
programme.desc: Un homme tombe amoureux d'une femme qui souffre de graves troubles de la mémoire à court terme.

programme.title: Jet Lag
programme.desc: Le directeur zélé d'une petite entreprise américaine et ses deux associés partent en Europe pour conclure le contrat le plus important de leurs carrières. Mais ce qui commence comme un simple voyage d'affaire dérape rapidement et l'équipée se retrouve dans des situations improbables...

programme.title: Détestables Nous
programme.desc: Trois amis d'enfance organisent un complot afin de trouver une copine pour Barry, leur ami d'enfance insupportable, vulgaire et désagréable. Leur plan se retourne contre eux quand sa nouvelle petite amie se révèle tout aussi détestable que lui.

programme.title: Made in America
programme.desc: La famille que l'on cherche n'est pas toujours celle que l'on imaginait.

programme.title: Le meilleur des temps
programme.desc: Un perdant d'une petite ville est déterminé à avoir une autre chance de gagner un match de football.

programme.title: Parmi les vautours
programme.desc: Des hors-la-loi déguisés en Indiens commettent des crimes contre les colons, mais Winnetou et Old Surehand sont déterminés à démasquer ces bandits.

programme.title: La charge des diables
programme.desc: Le capitaine Chadwell, le lieutenant Junger et le sergent Smith sont envoyés par Washington pour aider leurs collègues de Fort Apache à récupérer des armes volées.

programme.title: Quatre salopards pour Garringo
programme.desc: Une bande de malfaiteurs braque un convoi transportant de l'or destiné au Trésor public. Cette nuit-là, Farley vole l'or, mais on le retrouve mort le lendemain matin.

programme.title: Custer, l'homme de l'Ouest
programme.desc: L'amour de George Armstrong Custer pour les traditions héroïques du calvaire et son dégoût pour l'arrivée de l'industrialisation le conduisent à son destin à Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Quand il était petit, Johnny a vu son père tué par des soldats. Des années plus tard, il est devenu un hors-la-loi et tue des soldats chaque fois qu'il le peut. Le lieutenant Garringo (Steffen) est envoyé pour arrêter Johnny (Lawrence) et le ramener vivant.

programme.title: Quintana
programme.desc: Dans une province mexicaine opprimée par le diabolique gouverneur Don Juan de Leyra, le rebelle hors-la-loi Quintana est le seul gardien de la justice. Portant un poncho et se couvrant le visage d'un masque lorsqu'il est sur le sentier de la guerre, Quintana est une sorte de croisement entre Clint Eastwood et Zorro.

programme.title: Ardor
programme.desc: Un homme mystérieux surgit de la forêt tropicale argentine pour venir en aide à un pauvre fermier et à sa fille, menacés par une bande de mercenaires engagés pour les forcer à vendre leurs terres.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Envoyé dans le Montana pour traquer des braqueurs de banque, un chasseur de primes prend la place d'un shérif remplaçant qui n'est pas arrivé à destination et se retrouve impliqué dans une guerre territoriale entre agriculteurs et éleveurs.

programme.title: Clayton l'implacable
programme.desc: La soeur de Clayton a été violée et assassinée. C'est l'heure de la vengeance mortelle !

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: Le monde n'a pas de limite pour David Rice, qui peut se téléporter à souhait, jusqu'au jour où il se fait repérer par les paladins, une organisation secrète qui traque les Jumpers.

programme.title: Sharks
programme.desc: Le professeur Babish et ses élèves, en excursion en pleine mer, se retrouvent attaqués par un gigantesque requin à deux têtes. Se réfugiant sur une petite île secouée par des tremblements de terre, les survivants se préparent à survivre aux prochaines attaques du monstre

programme.title: Astral
programme.desc: Un étudiant universitaire en échec doit faire face aux conséquences de la projection astrale lorsqu'il l'utilise pour renouer avec sa mère décédée.

programme.title: La guerre des mondes: L'invasion
programme.desc: Trois amis fans d'astronomie cherchent le point d'impact de ce qu'ils croient être une météorite.

programme.title: The Blood Shark
programme.desc: Au large, des braconniers provoquent la colère d'un grand requin blanc en s'attaquant à son territoire.

programme.title: Behemoth
programme.desc: Sous la Terre, une créature géante enroulée autour de la planète se réveille et provoque des destructions mondiales.

programme.title: Snowmageddon
programme.desc: Une boule à neige mystique déclenche de vraies catastrophes et menace une ville d'Alaska.

programme.title: The Outpost: La violence ne résout rien
programme.desc: L'Outpost est submergé. Talon et Zed reviennent avec un allié inattendu, mais le dernier espoir exige un sacrifice.

programme.title: Robocop: Officier porté disparu
programme.desc: Un gang plonge Delta City dans le noir et tend un piège à Robocop, qui doit stopper une menace terroriste.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre: Le secret de Strandhill
programme.desc: Un guide irlandais découvre la possible tombe de Ma'el, dont les recherches sont cruciales pour les Taelons.

programme.title: Apocalypse polaire
programme.desc: Une famille traverse un monde gelé par une ère glaciaire soudaine pour atteindre une zone sûre.

programme.title: Alddyn
programme.desc: Trois sorciers enferment le mal dans trois boîtes magiques qu'ils jurent de protéger.

programme.title: Irati : Age of Gods and Monsters
programme.desc: Irati, une guerrière basque, affronte dieux et monstres dans une forêt oubliée.

programme.title: La Crypte du Dragon
programme.desc: Un groupe de chercheurs réveille une créature mythologique dans une crypte.

programme.title: Présentation du film Robert The Bruce

programme.title: Robert the Bruce
programme.desc: Suite de Braveheart et inspiré de faits réels épiques, le film raconte l'histoire d'un noble devenu hors-la-loi, héros qui fut couronné roi d'Écosse au XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Shark Warning
programme.desc: Vingt ans après, un homme revient dans la ville où son frère a été tué par un requin. Bientôt le prédateur refait surface et tue à nouveau, l'homme décide de le traquer pour l'arrêter une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: Year 10
programme.desc: Dans un monde dévasté, Jake affronte la barbarie pour sauver celle qu'il aime.

programme.title: Ape vs Mecha Ape
programme.desc: L'armée fabrique sa propre I.A. prête au combat : Mecha Ape.

programme.title: Great White Waters
programme.desc: Des millions en cocaïne sont engloutis tandis que des requins attaquent quiconque approche du butin.

programme.title: A l'ombre des regards
programme.desc: Holly se laisse dépérir depuis la mort de sa mère jusqu'à sa rencontre avec Shane.

programme.title: L'Assassinat de Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de la vie d'un vétéran afro-américain âgé atteint de trouble bipolaire.

programme.title: Kincsem
programme.desc: Après 1848, Blaskovich renaît grâce à Kincsem, cheval qui lui rend amour, gloire et vengeance.

programme.title: Le combat d'une femme
programme.desc: Après avoir été violée, Debbie Smith n'a pas pris la justice en main. Elle a créé sa propre loi.

programme.title: Le prix du secret
programme.desc: Le prix du secret est une histoire de trahison familiale, de perte d'amour et d'un sombre secret affectant une puissante famille politique du Sud profond. Kate découvre le passé de Logan, révélant des secrets de famille et la mettant en danger.

programme.title: True Story
programme.desc: Récemment renvoyé du New York Times pour avoir falsifié des informations, un journaliste se voit offrir une chance de rédemption lorsqu'un tueur en série assure s'être fait passer pour lui pendant des années.

programme.title: L'épreuve d'amour
programme.desc: Marielle's whole world collapses when she finds her husband Paul wearing one of her dresses. They've been married for 20 years, yet she has never suspected his unease. She doesn't even know that there is such a thing as "normal" men who wear women's clothes.

programme.title: Père et fille
programme.desc: Fathers and Daughters raconte l'histoire d'un père et de sa fille vivant à New York. Le récit alterne entre les années 1980, où Jake Davis (Russell Crowe), un romancier veuf gagnant d'un Pulitzer, lutte contre la maladie mentale alors qu'il tente d'élever sa fille de 5 ans Katie (Amanda Seyfried)...

programme.title: Témoins en sursis
programme.desc: Quand le FBI ne peut agir, l'ex-agent Price protège un témoin via son programme.

programme.title: A good mariage
programme.desc: Après 25 ans de mariage, que fera Darcy quand elle découvrira le terrible secret de son mari ?

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Drama
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Cinq hommes mariés se partagent secrètement un loft à New York pour assouvir tous leurs fantasmes.

programme.title: False Positive
programme.desc: Comme si tomber enceinte n'était pas assez compliqué, Lucy découvre la vérité sur son médecin.

Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.23

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.10
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. When pigments needed for overglaze painting run short, Mun Saseung turns to Hwa-ryeong for supplies—drawing Gangcheon straight to her. Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

programme.title: Bucketlist Australia
programme.desc: If Australia makes you think of beaches and BBQs, cricket and cork hats, you haven't seen anything yet. Giant deserts, ancient rainforest, tropical coasts and mystical rock formations. And not forgetting some of the weirdest and most wonderful animals on the planet. From iconic kangaroos and emus to the fearsome cassowary and cuddly koalas, you can find creatures here that you'll find nowhere else on the planet. There's only one place where you can find all these bucket list encounters – Australia!

programme.title: Bucketlist South America
programme.desc: One of the biggest continents crammed with adventures and possibilities, South America should be up there on any wildlife watcher's bucket list. From record breaking rivers and longest mountain ranges to the steepest waterfalls and most massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife. Here you can find the biggest rodents, otters and parrots, with unique mammals and marine life and spectacular predators. Make sure you don't miss South America!

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. Here dogs became our greatest allies. They're our eyes, ears, strength and stamina our closest connection to a wild and unforgiving nature. In this magical yet unforgiving land, the enduring bond between human and canine goes beyond friendship to total mutual dependence. As one of the oldest breeds in the world, Greenland dogs are celebrated as the pinnacle of high performance and endurance in polar regions.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey through the pristine waters of Raja Ampat. This Indonesian archipelago is home to some of the most beautiful and diverse marine life on the planet, including colorful fish and majestic Hawksbill Sea turtles. See the sheer beauty and vitality of this incredible ecosystem. From vibrant coral reefs and towering limestone cliffs to the dangerous ocean currents. A true celebration of nature's wonders and a powerful reminder of the importance of preserving our planet's delicate balance.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Sardinia is the second-largest island in the Mediterranean. The Sardin-ians themselves say it's a "continent for itself", a virtual world of its own, full of magic: A beach, gleaming in unreal pink shades, red corals protect against the evil eye and the inhabitants seem to remain forever young. On Sardinia, the owners of luxury yachts adopt sheep, fish have gold in their bellies and a giant mussel supplies the material for legendary sea silk. No one is surprised, that the Madonna goes on a sea cruise once a year.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Coasts
programme.desc: A cat shark out hunting, guillemots fearlessly jumping from the cliffs of Helgoland, the birth of a snow-white baby seal: the 2,400km of German coastlines are home to a unique diversity of species. Over thousands of years, the slow current of the North Sea has allowed silt to accumulate and form the unique world of the Wadden Sea, a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2009. Nowhere else in the world does such a landscape exist that, thanks to the tides, is in a constant state of change. On the Baltic Sea, it's above all the Bodden that are unique. They form a chain of shallow bodies of water connected to the sea by narrow channels. Here in the brackish water, only specialists can survive. The North Sea coast is famed for its extensive mud flats, the Halligen islands which are often submerged in winter and endless sandy beaches and dykes. Seals sun themselves on sandbanks and regenerate after the rigours of hunting. Plum in the middle of the North Sea, the cliffs of Helgoland are a paradise for seabirds like gannets, black-legged kittiwakes and guillemots. For the grey seals, the mating season begins in winter and with it fearsome battles between rival males. The largest bulls weigh in at 300kg and are the biggest mammals in Germany. Hunted mercilessly by fishermen competing for the same fish, for many years the seals had disappeared from Germany's coasts. Now they're under protection and are slowly returning. North and Baltic Seas have retained their original character. The Baltic has Darss, Rügen and Usedom, three of the most beautiful holiday destinations in the country and with the whitest beaches. In autumn, red deer stags stamp majestically along the sand against the foamy backdrop of the Baltic. Peregrine falcons, too, have made coast and islands their home.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: Getting Tthe Message
programme.desc: As the Friends enjoy Heartlake Amusement Park, Emma types a text to Mia, but sends it to Matthew by mistake a text that could be mega-embarrassing for Emma! As her BFF's, the Friends race to find Matthew's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, they must brave space rides, dunking booths and worse: the boys locker room! What's more frightening than a roller coaster? More innocent text to Mia was sent to Matthew by mistake -- a Friends' fun day at Heartlake Amusement Park turns into a undying love for Matthew! Mega-embarrassing! As Emma's phone and erase the text before he reads it. But first, BFF's, the Friends must scramble to retrieve Matthew's twisted than a funhouse mirror? A text gone wrong! The frantic race against time when Emma discovers that her text that accidentally sounds like a pledge of Emma's they need to brave space rides, dunking booths, an angry brute and worse - the boys locker room!

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.desc: A couple agree to have their deceased son cloned, but bizarre things happen several years after his rebirth.

programme.title: Insidious
programme.desc: A family tries to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Edge of the World
programme.desc: The Revenant meets Last of the Mohicans, this is the epic, swashbuckling adventure story that inspired The Man Who Would Be King. Starring Jonathan Rhys Meyers (The Tudors) as Sir James Brook, the English adventurer who fought pirates and slavery to rule a kingdom in the jungles of Borneo in 1840. programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Reverend Dwight Moore is at death's door when he is transferred from his local hospital to Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill. With all the expertise and technology of modern medicine at their disposal, doctors are still unable to find of the cause of Moore's symptoms, which include stomach pain, numbness, and hallucinations. His devoted wife Blanche remains by his side throughout his puzzling illness. She tries to comfort him by bringing his favorite banana pudding from home. When Moore's vital functions begin to shut down, a visiting specialist examines him and notices white striation lines on his fingernails, an indication of arsenic poisoning. Tests reveal that Moore has ingested more arsenic than any living person on record. Police investigators question him about his wife and discover that Blanche Moore's two previous husbands both met untimely deaths. Their bodies are exhumed and found to contain high levels of arsenic, and Blanche Moore is convicted of murder and sentenced to death.

programme.desc: When Sunwoo, currently hospitalized in the ICU, is scheduled for surgery, Minwoo struggles with how to break the news to Jaein. At the same time, a reporter named Kyungho arrives at the ER to investigate, publishing an article about Hansoo, who is hospitalized there—instantly thrusting the hospital into the media spotlight.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.9
programme.desc: A middle-aged man feigns illness and behaves inappropriately toward Jaein, leaving her deeply uncomfortable, but Minwoo steps in to defuse the situation and comfort her. Elsewhere, Minjun confidently enters the operating room, only to find that Wonguk's condition is far more critical than expected—leaving him powerless to intervene.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.10
programme.desc: Wonguk's condition suddenly deteriorates, forcing Minwoo and Jaein to rush into emergency treatment. As the media proposes producing a documentary about Wonguk's story, the hospital chairman orders Minjun to save the patient—regardless of who performs the surgery.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.11
programme.desc: The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, Jaein, and Minwoo face a harrowing dilemma: deciding who to operate on first—a kidnapper who knows the child's whereabouts, or an injured detective.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.12
programme.desc: Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.13
programme.desc: During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.14
programme.desc: As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter 10CM! 10CM is a solo act that initially started a band consisting of two members. The name referred to the height difference between them - 10 cm. In 2017 however one had to leave the group due to personal reasons and the main vocalist Kwon Jung-yeol continued on as a one-person band on his own under the name 10CM. In March 10CM held the first #TogetherAtHome concert in Korea after watching Coldplay singer Chris Martin perform a live concert online for people stuck indoors due to the spread of the coronavirus. Then in October the artist held a real-time online solo performance for the first time as a non-idol musician. In this episode 10CM performs songs from his latest album Winter Breath and Before Our Night Is Over as well as his hits pet Phonecert and Stalker to delight our ears and souls. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and fill your heart with Christmas vibes with 10CM!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Lim Heon-il! This artist made his big debut in the music scene after winning the Bronze Award at the 15th Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest in 2004. Since then he has actively pursued his career both as a guitarist and vocalist. As a guitarist he has played for a number of Korea's top artists including Kim Dong-ryul Lim Jae-beom and Lee So-ra. He's also been part of many renowned bands such as iamnot Mate Jeong Won-young Band and Band Bremen. Then in 2013 this artist transformed into a solo artist with the album Becoming a Love. Last year Lim Heon-il took part in Begin Again Season 3 and once again showed off his prowess as a guitarist and vocalist. Then in April this year he released his second album Breathe after a break of 7 years. All the songs in the album were composed written and produced by Lim Heon-il himself perfectly quenching listeners' thirst. In this episode Lim Heon-il performs Leave Home and Everything from his new album RBTY and many other songs to delight viewers. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy the essence of his artistry!

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.
